_meta.description: Databricks API token scopes — mapped to docs, descriptions, and project relevance.

sql.description: Run SQL queries and manage SQL warehouses (Databricks SQL).
sql.project_reason: Core compute for SQL experiment runs — replaces or augments local DuckDB.

clusters.description: Create, start, stop, and configure all-purpose and job compute clusters.
clusters.project_reason: Needed to run PySpark jobs (pyspark dependency in pyproject.toml) and experiment workers.

jobs.description: Create, run, monitor, and cancel Databricks workflow jobs.
jobs.project_reason: Schedule and trigger experiment loops instead of running them locally.

files.description: Upload and download files to/from DBFS and Unity Catalog Volumes.
files.project_reason: Transfer generated KPI SQL, workspace data inputs, and run.log artifacts.

secrets.description: Store and retrieve encrypted key-value secrets (API keys, connection strings).
secrets.project_reason: Safely store GEMINI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY used by LLMEngine.

mlflow.description: Log experiment runs, metrics, parameters, and artifacts via MLflow Tracking.
mlflow.project_reason: Natural fit for tracking primary_metric per experiment run; replaces results.tsv.

query-history.description: Access historical SQL query execution data including runtime and resource usage.
query-history.project_reason: Directly useful for SQL optimization task — surface slow queries and bottlenecks.

settings.description: Read and update workspace-level settings and configurations.
settings.project_reason: Basic workspace configuration required by most SDK operations.

unity-catalog.description: Govern and discover data assets (tables, volumes, schemas) across workspaces.
unity-catalog.project_reason: Useful if storing Delta Lake tables for prescriber data; not required for MVP.

pipelines.description: Build and manage Delta Live Tables (DLT) declarative data pipelines.
pipelines.project_reason: Could replace manual ETL steps with managed Delta pipelines in future.

workspace.description: Manage workspace objects: notebooks, folders, repos, and imports/exports.
workspace.project_reason: Needed only if storing notebooks or importing code directly into Databricks workspace.

environments.description: Manage serverless compute environment dependencies and library versions.
environments.project_reason: Useful for pinning Python package versions on serverless clusters.

libraries.description: Install and manage libraries on clusters (PyPI, Maven, DBFS).
libraries.project_reason: Install project dependencies (duckdb, polars, shap) on Databricks clusters.

vector-search.description: Create and query vector search indexes for semantic similarity retrieval.
vector-search.project_reason: No RAG or embedding features in the project.

model-serving.description: Deploy and query ML models as REST API endpoints.
model-serving.project_reason: Using external LLM APIs (Gemini, Anthropic) directly via APIEngine/CLIEngine.

custom-llms.description: Register and use custom or fine-tuned LLMs within Databricks AI Gateway.
custom-llms.project_reason: Direct API calls to Gemini/Anthropic; no need to route through Databricks.

ai-gateway.description: Centralized gateway for routing, rate-limiting, and monitoring LLM API calls.
ai-gateway.project_reason: LLM calls go directly to upstream providers; no proxy needed.

supervisor-agents.description: Orchestrate Mosaic AI Agents with tool use, memory, and multi-step reasoning.
supervisor-agents.project_reason: Project has its own intern/agent orchestration in core/; Databricks agents not used.

knowledge-assistants.description: Genie-powered natural language Q&A interface over your data.
knowledge-assistants.project_reason: No conversational data Q&A feature in the project.

genie.description: Natural language to SQL interface for Databricks data assets.
genie.project_reason: SQL is written and optimized by the agent itself, not via NL interface.

forecasting.project_reason: No forecasting workloads in the project.

databricks-connect.description: Run local Spark code remotely on a Databricks cluster.
databricks-connect.project_reason: Experiment scripts run inside Databricks Jobs, not hybrid local/remote.

dashboards.description: Create and manage Databricks Lakeview dashboards and legacy dashboards.
dashboards.project_reason: Dashboard runs locally via Dash/Plotly on port 8050 (dashboard.py).

apps.description: Deploy and host custom web applications on Databricks infrastructure.
apps.project_reason: Dash app runs locally; no need to host on Databricks.

qualitymonitor.description: Monitor data quality, drift, and model accuracy over time.
qualitymonitor.project_reason: Metric tracking handled by evaluator.py and results.tsv / MLflow.

dataquality.description: Define and enforce data quality rules on Delta tables.
dataquality.project_reason: No formal data quality enforcement needed for experiment data.

dataclassification.description: Automatically tag and classify sensitive data (PII, PHI) in tables.
dataclassification.project_reason: Prescriber data is already de-identified for the experiment.

sharing.description: Share data with external organizations via Delta Sharing protocol.
sharing.project_reason: No external data sharing in the project.

cleanrooms.description: Collaborate on sensitive data with other organizations without raw data exposure.
cleanrooms.project_reason: Single-org project; no clean room collaboration needed.

marketplace.description: Discover and install datasets, notebooks, and models from Databricks Marketplace.
marketplace.project_reason: Data comes from local CSV files, not Marketplace listings.

billing.description: Access DBU usage, cost, and billing reports.
billing.project_reason: Admin-level scope; not needed for running experiments.

provisioning.description: Create and delete workspaces at the account level.
provisioning.project_reason: Account-level admin scope; irrelevant for experiment workloads.

networking.description: Configure VPCs, private endpoints, and network policies.
networking.project_reason: Free trial workspace uses default networking.

disaster-recovery.description: Manage workspace backup and cross-region failover.
disaster-recovery.project_reason: Not relevant for a free trial or experimental workload.

scim.description: Provision and sync users/groups via the SCIM 2.0 identity protocol.
scim.project_reason: Single-user account; no SSO or user provisioning needed.

identity.description: Manage service principals, groups, and permission assignments.
identity.project_reason: Personal account with personal access token; no identity management needed.

authentication.description: Configure SSO, OAuth, and token-based authentication policies.
authentication.project_reason: Already authenticated via personal access token.

access-management.description: Manage role assignments and permissions across workspace objects.
access-management.project_reason: Single-user workspace; no ACL management needed.

instance-profiles.description: Attach AWS IAM instance profiles to clusters for S3 and resource access.
instance-profiles.project_reason: AWS-specific scope; not applicable unless migrating to AWS.

instance-pools.description: Pre-allocate idle VMs to reduce cluster start time.
instance-pools.project_reason: Useful at scale, but unnecessary on free trial with occasional runs.

global-init-scripts.description: Run shell scripts on every cluster at startup (workspace-wide).
global-init-scripts.project_reason: Dependencies are managed via pyproject.toml / uv, not cluster init scripts.

command-execution.description: Execute arbitrary code on a running cluster via the Commands API.
command-execution.project_reason: Use Jobs API instead; direct command execution is interactive and not reproducible.

notifications.description: Create notification destinations (email, Slack, PagerDuty) for job alerts.
notifications.project_reason: No alerting pipeline wired up in the project.

alerts.description: Set threshold-based alerts on SQL query results.
alerts.project_reason: Metric evaluation is handled by evaluator.py, not SQL alerts.

search.description: Search across workspace objects: notebooks, jobs, queries, dashboards.
search.project_reason: No search-driven workflows in the project.

tags.description: Apply key-value tags to clusters, jobs, and other resources for cost tracking.
tags.project_reason: No cost attribution tagging required on free trial.

postgres.description: Connect to and query external PostgreSQL databases via Lakehouse Federation.
postgres.project_reason: Data source is CSV files, not a Postgres database.
